entries.0957d707d4099afe: In the tugboat business, it operates tugboat services that assist large vessels in berthing and unberthing and pilot boats; in the marine-related business, it operates crew transfer vessels (CTV) for offshore wind power generation and ship chartering; and in the passenger ship business, it operates a car ferry connecting Kurihama and Kanaya.
entries.3179a4799d401d28: This is a business model in which the company operates marine-related businesses such as operation of crew transfer vessels for offshore wind power generation, centered on tugboat services, and passenger ship businesses such as car ferries, and earns revenue from fees for operation services and passenger fares.
entries.34aceb692dd6a670: This business centers on operating crew transfer vessels (CTVs) that carry offshore wind power workers to generation facilities at sea, and also includes in-port crew transfer boat services, charter services for owned vessels, and the maritime disaster prevention business.

entries.5395f37760d5d6a3: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥13,144 million, consisting of ¥9,517 million for the tugboat business, ¥1,956 million for the marine-related business and ¥1,670 million for the passenger ship business.
entries.62bc94f643607638: This business is operated by consolidated subsidiary Tokyo Wan Ferry Co., Ltd., which runs car ferries connecting Kurihama Port in Kanagawa Prefecture and Kanaya Port in Chiba Prefecture. It also includes shop and restaurant operations at the ferry terminals. Sightseeing boat operations at Yokohama Port have been handled since May 2025 by equity-method affiliate YCruise Co., Ltd.
entries.650a50cee3edab46: This business centers on operating crew transfer vessels (CTVs) that carry offshore wind power workers to generation facilities at sea, and also includes in-port crew transfer boat services, charter services for owned vessels, and the maritime disaster prevention business. The company and consolidated subsidiary Port Service Co., Ltd. handle this business.
entries.673819701e856506: At ports around Tokyo Bay, this business provides tugboat services, including harbor tugs that assist large vessels in berthing and unberthing, and escort tugs that escort vessels on routes such as the Uraga Channel.
entries.6ecc166cb6419e2a: Tokyo Kisen Co., Ltd. is a shipping company founded in 1947 and headquartered in Yokohama, with 'support for maritime safety' as its corporate philosophy.
entries.7c44ba1d311d04e6: Net income attributable to owners of parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,046 million.

entries.a345a752a8e7019d: At ports around Tokyo Bay, this business provides tugboat services, including harbor tugs that assist large vessels in berthing and unberthing, and escort tugs that escort vessels on routes such as the Uraga Channel. It also operates pilot boats at the entrance to Tokyo Bay and provides guard boat services that accompany vessels carrying dangerous goods. The company and consolidated subsidiaries Tōkō Service Co., Ltd. and Tōa Kisen Co., Ltd. handle this business.
